feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 8 (y=0.045, ±0.055, base_speed 1.6) had 0.95 line losses on s-bend and 1.0 on slalom, with s-bend progress 0.147 and slalom 0.100. Iteration 7 (y=0.06, ±0.055) had 0.9 and 1.0 losses, so the losses did not clear with the forward row moved back. Iteration 5 (y=0.03, ±0.05) had zero losses but only 0.040 s-bend progress. I changed only base_speed, to 1.4, and kept the iteration 8 geometry. If losses clear and s-bend progress holds near 0.14, keep the geometry and test the footprint next. If losses persist at 1.4, speed is not the cause and the geometry must change. The oval max_error floor (0.060 to 0.063 in every design) has not moved under any change so far, so I do not expect the speed change to move it.
requested_changes: If line_loss_events fall to 0 on s-bend and slalom at base_speed 1.4 and s-bend progress stays at or above 0.14, keep y=0.045 and ±0.055, and set sensor_size to 0.012 to test whether the oval max_error floor moves. Iteration 8 showed the footprint has not been isolated at a forward row.

If line losses persist at base_speed 1.4, keep the controller and try y=0.05 with the outer sensors widened to ±0.06. Iteration 2 showed ±0.06 removed losses at y=0.03, and iteration 0 used y=0.05, so the intermediate row has only been tested under a different span.

If losses clear but s-bend progress falls below 0.14, return the row to y=0.06 with ±0.05 and keep base_speed 1.4. Iteration 6 (y=0.06, ±0.05, base_speed 1.6) gave the best progress so far, at 0.157 on s-bend, so that row is the progress reference.
